attchmntText: The Great Eastern Shipping Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
sm_name: The Great Eastern Shipping Company Limited
voiceSummary: The Great Eastern Shipping Company Limited filed transcripts of its earnings call held on November 11, 2026, regarding financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Executive Director and CFO G. Shivakumar reported a profitable quarter with the highest ever net asset value. An interim dividend of INR14.40 per share was maintained. Suezmax spot earnings spiked due to risk premiums in the Strait of Hormuz and Black Sea, excluding these areas, average earnings were USD350,000 to USD400,000 per day. Rates subsequently dropped to USD130,000 to USD150,000 per day due to shuttle services reducing efficiency. Product tanker rates remain strong at USD50,000 to USD60,000 per day. Dry bulk earnings are profitable, with Capesize rates at USD30,000 to USD35,000 per day. LPG spot rates reached USD140,000 per day, though the company’s fleet is on fixed time charters. The company added two vessels, Jag Amit and Jag Vikrant, and committed to a Kamsarmax and a new Suezmax. Two Suezmaxes were fixed on one-year charters.
